name: knight
description: A crowned knight on the humanoid rig: plate armour with gold trim, a royal blue surcoat with a gold cross, a folded red cape, a great helm with a plume, a longsword in the right hand and a curved heater shield on the left arm. Left limbs are mirrored to the right.

parts.description: A great helm with a gold-edged eye slit.
The gold cross pattee of the knight's order.
The surcoat's flared skirt, split front and back for riding; the cut edges show gold.
An empty scabbard hanging from the left hip.
A longsword held in the right fist, tipped 40 degrees down from forward about the grip.
A curved heater shield on the left forearm, its face turned outward: gold rim, blue field, gold cross, leather back.
